## Context
The coordinator and fuse remain inert until non-create families route through them. Cutover must preserve independent work, explicitly defer matching plans, and prove the new fuse would not have prematurely stopped historical successful or partially successful jobs.

## Outcome
Make typed coordination authoritative for non-create families behind an internal per-family rollback selector, persist explicit deferral metadata, add the new endpoint-failure scoped fuse (retaining the blast-radius mass-mutation guard `classify.check_blast_radius`), and emit exact pass outcomes.

## Plan
1. Venue-gate verified-fake Cloud/DC summary behavior, then change the internal operation-family default from legacy to coordinator; never dual-send.
2. Route update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, and conflict plans through coordinator/fuse. Preserve successful effects and recover rollback by re-observation.
3. Defer remaining matching plans with scope/reason/`retry_not_before`; let independent scopes continue.
4. Preserve exact applied/failed/deferred/skipped/recovered tallies and nonzero degraded-pass signaling.
5. Replay the sanitized 1,200-run completed GitHub Actions slice. Count only normalized terminal outcomes, never warning/grep text, and prove zero premature termination of observed successful/partial work.

## Testing
Verified-fake batches assert wire order/call ceilings/tallies/logs/exit. Historical replay names any counterfactual stop and blocks if it predates observed later success.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Each non-create family has one coordinator route and one internal legacy rollback value with no dual-send.
- [ ] Venue-gated Cloud/DC verified fakes pass before the coordinator default changes.
- [ ] Matching remaining work is deferred with exact scope, reason, and `retry_not_before`, while independent scopes continue.
- [ ] Applied, failed, deferred, skipped, and recovered tallies plus degraded exit status are exact.
- [ ] Migrated families route failure fusing through the new endpoint-failure scoped fuse; legacy ad-hoc retry nesting is unreachable for them and the blast-radius mass-mutation guard remains in force.
- [ ] Historical replay of the completed 1,200-run slice shows zero premature stop before observed successful or partially successful work.

## Out of scope
Create coordination remains S4; final legacy removal remains S5.
## Impacted sites (existing dispatch seams the cutover rewires)
Routes the S3 T1 coordinator + T2 fuse into real non-create dispatch behind an internal per-family selector; additive, never dual-send.
- `applier.py` (**784 LOC — only 16 under the 800 cap; the cutover MUST NOT grow it past 800**): `apply` (:359), `_apply_batch` (:538), `_apply_one` (:727) are where non-create families dispatch today. Route them through `coordinator.coordinate(...)`; net-new wiring lands in the coordinator/dispatch-phase modules or a small new selector, NOT by inflating applier.py.
- `batch_dispatch.py` (148 LOC): `delete_one` (:54), `_mutation_to_batch_dict` — the legacy compound-replay/rolling-breaker path retired for migrated families (unreachable for them, retained for create until S4/S5).
- `dispatch_apply_phases.py` (694 LOC): `_call_with_retry` (:76) is the legacy ad-hoc nested per-call retry that becomes UNREACHABLE for migrated families (they fuse through T2's `pass_fuse` instead); phase dispatch carries deferral/fuse/exact phase outcomes.
- `coordinator.py` `coordinate(...)` / `CoordinationReport` (S3 T1) and `pass_fuse.py` (S3 T2) — the entry points routed into; consumed as-is.
- `classify.check_blast_radius` — the pre-existing blast-radius mass-mutation guard; a DISTINCT protection, retained in force and untouched (AC5).
- Operation-family selector: the internal `legacy | coordinator` per-family default flips to `coordinator`; the `legacy` value is the internal rollback path (AC1), never a dual-send.
- `tests/fixtures/reconciler/rp03_fuse_completed_slice.json` (new): the sanitized 1,200-run completed GitHub Actions slice; the replay counts only normalized terminal outcomes (never warning/grep text) and must show zero premature stop before observed successful/partial work (AC6).

Create coordination (S4) and final legacy removal (S5) stay out of scope.
